description: This file provides functions for handling XAI (Explainable AI) authentication, including reading API keys from configuration, resolving fallback methods, and checking if the XAI tool is enabled.

methods.name: readConfiguredOrManagedApiKey
methods.description: Reads an API key from a value, either directly or via a secret reference.

methods.name: readLegacyGrokFallbackAuth
methods.description: Retrieves fallback authentication info from legacy grok configuration.

methods.name: readLegacyGrokApiKey
methods.description: Reads the legacy grok API key from configuration.

methods.name: readPluginXaiWebSearchApiKey
methods.description: Reads the XAI web search API key from plugin configuration.

methods.name: resolveFallbackXaiAuth
methods.description: Resolves fallback authentication info, prioritizing plugin config then legacy grok.

methods.name: resolveFallbackXaiApiKey
methods.description: Resolves the XAI API key, trying plugin config then legacy grok.

methods.name: resolveXaiToolApiKey
methods.description: Resolves the XAI tool API key from runtime config, source config, or environment.

methods.name: isXaiToolEnabled
methods.description: Determines if the XAI tool is enabled based on configuration and API key availability.
